description: A soda company sends bottles of their soda to stores around the city in old and new vans. An old van can take 100 soda bottles while a new van can take 80 soda bottles. An old van produces 50 units of pollution while a new van only produces 30 units of pollution. The company needs to send at least 5000 bottles. In addition, at most 30 new vans can be used. How many of each van should be used to minimize the total amount of pollution produced?

OldVanCapacity.definition: Capacity of an old van in soda bottles

NewVanCapacity.definition: Capacity of a new van in soda bottles

OldVanPollution.definition: Pollution produced by an old van in units

NewVanPollution.definition: Pollution produced by a new van in units

MinimumBottles.definition: Minimum number of soda bottles that need to be sent

MaximumNewVans.definition: Maximum number of new vans that can be used

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of pollution produced by the old and new vans used to transport the soda bottles"

constraints.description: 100 * (number of old vans) + 80 * (number of new vans) must be at least 5000
The number of new vans used must be less than or equal to 30
The number of old vans used must be a nonnegative integer
The number of new vans used must be a nonnegative integer
